description:
Compare two to five products side-by-side across dimensions.
asins: a list of 2-5 valid ASINs (10-char alphanumeric, e.g. "B08N5WRWNW").
Fewer than 2 or more than 5 items returns an error.
facts_check reports, per ASIN, the five verdict counts across its fact-checked claims:
corroborated, contradicted, insufficient, unmentioned_in_reviews, amz_not_disclosed.
name: compare_products
